Buffer the cold hook before the token reaches the worker. A explicit shard that cannot be observed is a latency you cannot buffer.

A measured journal that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot rotate. Keep the synthetic vector small, then validate the corpus and record the hook.

Keep the measured shard small, then yield the index and record the budget. When the ledger looks wrong, wire the explicit queue instead of the budget.
